# Boxed
> Boxed is a calm Shikaku logic puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 17+), in English and Arabic, by Mohamed ElZoghbi (ZaPlatform, Egypt). Split the grid into boxes so each box holds one number equal to its area. Free with ads; a one-time "Remove ads" purchase. No account.

## Pages
- [Boxed (English)](https://boxed.zaplatform.com/): what Shikaku is, rules, tips, modes, price, FAQ, support
- [Boxed بالعربية](https://boxed.zaplatform.com/ar/): الصفحة العربية
- [Privacy policy](https://boxed.zaplatform.com/privacy/)
- [سياسة الخصوصية](https://boxed.zaplatform.com/ar/privacy/)

## Facts
- Daily: three boards a day, the same for everyone: Daily 5×5, Hard 7×7, Expert 10×10
- Endless: 5×5 to 12×12, three difficulties
- Journey: 12 chapters, 372 levels (30 + 1 Impossible per chapter)
- Time trial: three minutes
- Every board has exactly one solution
- Shape traps on Hard and Expert boards
- Plays offline: every board is made on the iPhone; only ads and the purchase need a connection
- Language: English and Arabic; follows the iPhone's language, switchable in Settings
- iPhone only (iOS 17 or later); iPad isn't supported; Android is coming later
- Progress stays on the device; no account
- Contact: zaplatform@gmail.com
